audited_code: JSphCpu.cpp InitDynamicPoreWallCpu rejects all nonzero gravity.
ComputeDynamicPoreWallStateCpu currently mirrors scalar pressure evenly and effective stress as Q*sigma*Q; its admitted wall scope has zero gravity.
ComputeDynamicPoreWallAccelerationCpu already implements Q*(Ace+g)-g on CPU, with Q=I-2*n*nT for the admitted axis plane.
hydraulic_normal_gravity: At an impermeable stationary plane a_s dot n=0 and q dot n=0 imply grad(p) dot n = rho_w*g dot n. A necessary constant-rho_w pressure extension is p_b=p_m-rho_w*(g dot B), equivalently even perturbations about pH=rho_w*g dot x. The distance is B, not B/2; rho_w is not mixture rho.
mechanical_normal_gravity: Static equilibrium independently requires div(effective_sigma)=-(rho-rho_w)*g. Merely adding the pressure offset while leaving an arbitrary stress even can destroy total-stress balance. A background extension sigma_b=sigmaH(xb)+Q*(sigma_m-sigmaH(xm))*Q needs a declared physical background. An isotropic prestress, only-normal load and a laterally confined self-weight column are different problems; do not silently interchange them. Variable J also changes rho, so a general background is not just a constant-density offset.
known_spatial_limit: The separately sealed raw-force audit has about 1.77-2.38 percent regular-support first-moment hydrostatic residual. A wall-only offset cannot remove that interior defect. Do not receiver-correct the force alone, lose pair conservation, or interpret an unsupported finite-patch edge without applied traction as a wall failure.
